newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pacifica says in talks with PT Citra unit.
newsitem.headline: Pacifica says in talks with PT Citra unit.

text.p: Philippine firm Pacifica Inc said on Wednesday it was negotiating with Strategic Alliance Development Corp (Stradec), a subsidiary of PT Citra of Indonesia, for a possible tie-up.
Pacifica told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Stradec might susbcribe to its unissued shares, although company officials were unavailable to say how large a stake it represented.
"No definitive agreement has been reached at the present," the company said.
"If negotiations are not successfully concluded by June 29, 1997, the corporation will consider these negotiations terminated and will be entertaining and considering other proposals," it added.
Pacifica Inc is an oil explorer, but recently decided to venture into infrastructure building. Pacifica closed 0.25 centavos higher at seven centavos per share on Wednesday.
Philippine newspaper BusinessWorld said on Wednesday that Stradec had bagged a 1.9 billion peso worth contract for the expansion of the South Luzon Expressway in the Philippines.
The report quoted an unnamed official of the Department of Public Works and Highways.
